scope: database read paths; no production changes, source database rescan or new REA session

provider_limitations: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
References cover the complete Ghidra function-body AddressSet and exact entry. Dossier incoming edges omit sources owned by that function; procedure_references also retains those internal edges.
The dossier combines Ghidra FunctionManager, Listing, ReferenceManager, BasicBlockModel, and decompiler observations; provider-specific pseudocode and assembly are not cross-provider text invariants.

Resolved reference metadata identifies computed, indirect, external, call, jump, and data edges; unresolved targetless flows remain unknown, and function classifications distinguish thunks and externals.
Synthetic Ghidra entry-point references without actionable memory sources are omitted.
The Java bridge serializes one function request per Program and lets each decompilation run until it completes or the caller cancels.
This session uses Ghidra 12.1.3. The bridge is verified against 12.1.4; other 12.1.x builds are accepted and the observed version is reported.

findings.classification: static observation cross-checked against GNU assembly
findings.claim: ISODATA is trimmed and concatenated with const.dat. Each read supplies a 4-byte integer index and 8-byte real target. constant_ initializes lazily and checks lookup bounds.
findings.limit: Original Fortran declarations and malformed-input robustness are not fully recovered.

findings.classification: static observation plus independently read ELF bytes
findings.claim: Starting at even index 2, adjacent odd slots receive binary64 sign-bit-flipped values. Actual slot stride is 8 bytes.
findings.limit: No proof that every matrix integer is a direct constant_ index, especially zero.

findings.claim: get_irreps_ calls get_irrep4_, which calls get_irrep4_ssgn_. Matrix and diagonal-sum output branches, dimensions, common_little_ loads and magnetic mapping/sign branches are visible. Neither reviewed function directly calls constant_.
findings.limit: get_irrep4_ssgn_ and field-to-common-block loading map remain unreviewed; phase, complex basis and normalization contracts are not recovered.

findings.classification: static observation with text-supported state-role inference
findings.claim: i/k/a/v .iso naming, get_isotropy_filename_ calls, missing/in-progress branches, conditional get_isotropy_ calls and mode-5 dimension check are visible.
findings.limit: No direct data_isotropy.txt or .iso body parser in this function. Full keys, cache location, locking and generation algorithms remain in callees. Numeric modes are not mapped to website Methods.

findings.claim: MAIN__ pseudocode request returned isError true, was not counted as successful evidence, and was not retried by this review.

review_check_history: Initial check incorrectly required an explicit isError:false field. It failed without writing output; the actual successful MCP responses omit the optional isError field. Final check preserves that absence.
